# Content & files blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The Content & files blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## documents

Yjs documents attached to any subject: an update log, a compacted snapshot, a private realtime topic per document for updates and presence, suggestions that editors accept into the log, and named versions through the versions module.

- Title: Collaborative documents
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/documents
- Client: `documentsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/documents`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `queue`, `versions`
- Entities: `document`, `document_suggestion`
- Tables: `documents`, `document_suggestions`
- Permission keys: `documents.read`, `documents.write`, `documents.suggest`, `documents.manage`
- Events (`DocumentsEvents`): `document.created`, `document.suggested`, `document.suggestion_accepted`, `document.suggestion_rejected`

## drive

Folders and files on the attachments module: access granted to users, teams or roles and inherited down the tree, enforced by storage policies too; moves and renames with a name-conflict policy; revisions through versions, a bin through trash, starred and recent items through share-links' user state, and folder share links.

- Title: Drive
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/drive
- Client: `driveBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/drive`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `drive-files`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `attachments`, `versions`, `trash`, `teams`, `share-links`, `settings`, `guests`, `imports`, `data-lifecycle`, `access-requests`
- Entities: `drive_node`
- Tables: `drive_nodes`
- Permission keys: `drive.read`, `drive.create`, `drive.manage`
- Events (`DriveEvents`): `drive_node.created`, `drive_node.download_blocked_changed`, `drive_node.hold_placed`, `drive_node.hold_released`, `drive_node.locked`, `drive_node.moved`, `drive_node.ownership_transferred`, `drive_node.renamed`, `drive_node.shared`, `drive_node.unlocked`, `drive_node.unshared`
- Consumes: `attachments (optional)`, `recordAccess (optional)`

## drive-files

The part of the drive module that needs attachments, versions, trash and share-links: file uploads and revisions with an optional usage quota, extracted text, storage policies, the bin, starred and recent items, folder share links and the purge event. Installed with drive.

- Title: Drive files
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/drive
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `attachments`
- Works with: `drive`, `outbox`, `audit`, `attachments`, `versions`, `trash`, `teams`, `share-links`, `settings`, `guests`, `imports`, `data-lifecycle`, `tags`, `approvals`, `rate-limit`, `usage`, `numbering`, `state-machine`, `relations`, `acknowledgements`, `notifications`

## forms

Forms with numbered versions (steps and show or skip logic), a JSON Schema 2020-12 per version that validates every submission, drafts, public links through share-links with a rate limit and a bot-check hook, handlers that turn a submission into a record, scoring against an answer key respondents can't read, and NPS rollups.

- Title: Forms
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/forms
- Client: `formsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/forms`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `jsonb-schemas`
- Works with: `custom-fields`, `share-links`, `rate-limit`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `form`
- Tables: `forms`
- Permission keys: `forms.read`, `forms.manage`, `forms.submit`, `forms.review`
- Events (`FormsEvents`): `form.created`, `form_submission.archived`, `form_submission.purged`, `form_submission.restored`, `form_submission.reviewed`, `form_submission.submitted`, `form_version.published`

## signatures

Simple electronic signatures on a frozen version of a record: drawn, typed or click signatures in parallel or in order, a hash that detects edits after signing, and an approval step a signer can decide.

- Title: Signatures
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/signatures
- Client: `signaturesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/signatures`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `versions`
- Works with: `approvals`, `attachments`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `signature_request`
- Tables: `signature_requests`
- Permission keys: `signatures.read`, `signatures.request`, `signatures.manage`
- Events (`SignaturesEvents`): `signature_request.cancelled`, `signature_request.completed`, `signature_request.declined`, `signature_request.requested`, `signature_request.signed`

## templates

Typed, versioned templates (system starters and tenant forks) that create records, with merge fields and workflows started on each record they create.

- Title: Templates
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/templates
- Client: `templatesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/templates`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `recurrence`
- Works with: `outbox`, `audit`, `workflow-editor`, `jsonb-schemas`, `reminders`
- Entities: `template`
- Tables: `templates`
- Permission keys: `templates.read`, `templates.apply`, `templates.manage`
- Events (`TemplatesEvents`): `template.applied`, `template.published`

## courses

Courses of modules and lessons ordered by rank keys, with quiz lessons graded by forms, per-lesson progress, completion and certificates. Each course runs as an enrollment program, so learners enroll through enrollments.

- Title: Courses
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/courses
- Client: `coursesBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/courses`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `enrollments`
- Works with: `forms`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `course`, `course_module`, `course_lesson`, `course_certificate`
- Tables: `courses`, `course_modules`, `course_lessons`, `course_certificates`
- Permission keys: `courses.read`, `courses.enroll`, `courses.manage`
- Events (`CoursesEvents`): `course.archived`, `course.completed`, `course.created`, `course.enrolled`, `course.purged`, `course.restored`, `course.unenrolled`, `course.updated`, `course_certificate.issued`, `course_certificate.revoked`, `course_lesson.completed`

## content

Typed, localized content entries per organization, such as pages and posts, with a slug unique per type and locale. Entries are drafted, scheduled and published, optionally through approvals, and anyone can read published entries.

- Title: Content
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/content
- Client: `contentBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/content`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `approvals`, `versions`, `attachments`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `content_entry`
- Tables: `content_entries`
- Permission keys: `content.read`, `content.write`, `content.publish`
- Events (`ContentEvents`): `content_entry.archived`, `content_entry.created`, `content_entry.published`, `content_entry.restored`, `content_entry.scheduled`, `content_entry.unscheduled`, `content_entry.updated`

## dam

Renditions of drive files (thumbnails and web sizes made through the drive's preview renderers) and usage rights with a territory, a channel and an expiry date, with a reminder before a right ends.

- Title: Digital asset management
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/dam
- Client: `damBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/dam`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `subjects`
- Works with: `drive`, `outbox`, `audit`, `notifications`
- Entities: `dam_usage_right`, `dam_rendition`
- Tables: `dam_usage_rights`, `dam_renditions`
- Permission keys: `dam.read`, `dam.write`
- Events (`DamEvents`): `dam_rendition.recorded`, `dam_usage_right.granted`, `dam_usage_right.revoked`
